CustomField.description: When enabled, this product will automatically generate ramp line items in the quote - one for each Committed Period based on the subscription term and the product's unit-of-measure (UOM) term dimension. For example, a 12-month subscription with a quarterly term dimension will generate four ramped Committed Periods.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When enabled, this product will automatically generate ramp line items in the quote - one for each Committed Period based on the subscription term and the product's unit-of-measure (UOM) term dimension. CustomField.label: Enable Committed Period Ramping
